name: Fusion
principle: Fusion would release energy by joining light nuclei, using magnetic confinement (tokamak, stellarator) or inertial confinement. NIF achieved ignition in December 2022 and a record 8.6 MJ yield in April 2025; ITER now plans research operation in 2034 and deuterium-tritium operation in 2039, and no fusion plant has delivered electricity.

process_steps.name: Neutrons heat a lithium blanket that breeds tritium
